Keeping track of client conversations can be tricky when you're juggling multiple inboxes. But don't worry, we've made it super easy to sync your Gmail or Outlook inbox right into Eleva. This means you'll see all your customer interactions in one unified place, so you'll never miss an important follow-up again.

Connect Gmail or Outlook


Ready to streamline your email management? Here's how you can quickly connect your inbox:

  1. Go to Settings > My Profile > Email (2-way sync).

  2. Choose Gmail or Outlook, then click Connect.


  3. Follow the prompts to accept permissions. It's safe and secure!

You will see these four points in Before you connect your Gmail or Outlook when you connect, and you can review them at any time from Settings > My Profile > Email and conversations > How email sync works.


What to Expect After You Connect

Connecting your inbox changes what enters the CRM and who can see it. Four things to know:

  • Email with people already in your CRM starts syncing. Email with people who are not yet contacts does not sync automatically.
  • Other users in this sub-account can read your synced emails. Synced email sits on the contact record, where everyone with Conversations access can open it.
  • If you belong to more than one location, sync can reach all of them. Sync follows your user account rather than a single location.
  • Disconnecting later will not remove emails already synced. Everything already in the CRM stays there.


Auto Bcc Sync

Auto Bcc Sync allows you to include the smart Bcc address in the Cc or Bcc field when sending an email from Outlook. Doing so will automatically add the conversation and contact to your CRM, streamlining communication and ensuring all relevant data is centralized.


Want to keep some email out?

You do not have to connect the whole inbox. Add your Bcc address to the Cc or Bcc field of an individual email instead, and only that conversation comes into the CRM.

Use Your Connected Email


Now that you've got your inbox connected, you're all set to manage your emails directly from Eleva. Here's how simple it is to start sending emails:

  1. Navigate to Conversations.

  2. Click on Create New Message (the pencil-on-paper icon).

  3. Select Direct Message.



  4. Choose your contact and click Continue.



  5. Your connected email address will automatically populate in the "From" field.



Email you exchange with existing contacts syncs both ways — from CRM to your personal inbox and back again. Email with people who are not yet contacts does not sync automatically.
